text:
Emilia Hart: Quick thread 15min sync idea: run a small PLG funnel experiment that ties a launch post + 12-min microwebinar + a benchmark narrative in comms. goal = lift prompt-template adoption and speed to first API call.
Derek Liu: sounds actionable. what's the main hypothesis?
Emilia Hart: hypothesis: readers who consume the launch narrative + attend a short webinar and receive a milestone credit will try curated templates faster and more often than credits-alone.
Sophie Nguyen: propose a 4-arm split, N=800: (1) post+webinar+$20 milestone credit, (2) post+$20 credit only, (3) post+$5 read credit, (4) post only control. run 2 weeks.
Derek Liu: routing: utm=launch_webinar -> arm1, social_ads -> randomize between arm2 and arm3, organic search -> randomize among all arms. cap webinar seating to 320. overflow -> waitlist + $5.
Emilia Hart: benchmark narrative: short case study + 3 benchmark metrics (time to first useful response, tokens saved by template, percent switched to API). include in landing and replay email.
Sophie Nguyen: onboarding treatment for arm1: show a 4-card prompt playbook with one-click "Try" that auto-runs a sample query. flag name: mkt/seedplaybook_v3. canary to 40.
ops-bot: created flag mkt/seedplaybook_v3 (canary=40) :white_check_mark:
Derek Liu: tracking events: launch_post_view, launch_post_read, webinar_invite_sent, webinar_attended, playbook_shown, playbook_tried, milestone_credit_redeemed, first_api_call_ts.
Emilia Hart: experiment metrics: week1_template_use_pct, time_to_first_api_call_median, pct_with_repeat_use_7d, avg_spend_30d. also capture qualitative feedback via 1-question survey after webinar.
Sophie Nguyen: email cadence for arm1: invite, -48h reminder, -1h reminder, replay+redeem link. include benchmark highlights in the replay.
Derek Liu: quick config snippet 
```yaml
experiment_id: seed_playbook_launch_1951
cohort_target: 800
arms:
  - name: post_webinar_milestone
    webinar_invite: true
    milestone_credit_usd: 20
  - name: post_credit_only
    webinar_invite: false
    milestone_credit_usd: 20
  - name: post_read_small_credit
    webinar_invite: false
    milestone_credit_usd: 5
  - name: post_control
    webinar_invite: false
    milestone_credit_usd: 0
metrics:
  - week1_template_use_pct
  - time_to_first_api_call_median
  - repeat_use_7d_pct
traffic_rules:
  - if: utm==launch_webinar -> assign:post_webinar_milestone
  - if: source==social_ads -> random_assign(post_credit_only, post_read_small_credit)
  - else: random_assign(all_arms)
```
Emilia Hart: owners: landing + narrative = Sophie, webinar slides + short demo = Emilia, FF & onboarding push = ops (Derek to verify), analytics = Derek, credits ops = @finance-ops.
Sophie Nguyen: I'll draft landing copy emphasizing a benchmark mini-case ("how ACME cut prompt costs 3x with templates") and short CTAs.
Derek Liu: I'll wire the dashboard and add alerts for early signal (48h template_try_rate).
Emilia Hart: schedule: landing + email copy by Tue EOD, FF ready and canary by Tue noon, launch Wed AM. please react with :thumbsup: if you approve.
Sophie Nguyen: :thumbsup:
Derek Liu: :thumbsup:
Emilia Hart: thanks team 1 will set a 10-min runbook tomorrow to finalize rollout. :rocket:
